newsitem.title: USA: Aberdeen, Md., mayor seeks to fund stadium - paper.
newsitem.headline: Aberdeen, Md., mayor seeks to fund stadium - paper.

text.p: Aberdeen, Md., Mayor Charles Boutin is trying to raise about $12 million to bring a minor league baseball stadium to the city, Baltimore Sun reported.

The plan, which would involve bringing a single-A team to Aberdeen, includes $1 million from an anonymous donor who wants naming rights, the newspaper said. Another $2 million would come from the Maryland Baseball Limited Partnership, which owns other teams in the state.
Boutin hopes some combination of state, county and local funding would provide the rest, but government officials are so far reluctant, according to the paper.
